title: The Still Path Where Others Learned

features.name: the-place-where-footprints-stop
features.desc-on-touch: where many arrived and learned that arrival wasn't the point—the path ends here, but ending here teaches you that paths have reasons to stop

features.name: the-teaching-stone
features.desc-on-touch: a smooth rock worn by the weight of those who sat here and understood—the stone has learned their names even though they never spoke them

features.name: the-sky-that-teaches-staying
features.desc-on-touch: the blue here is so high, so settled, that it teaches the air not to move—you understand why climbers came here to learn what not-climbing feels like

features.name: the-mark-where-rest-is-written
features.desc-on-touch: carved here or worn here, a glyph that repeats—each person who came added a mark without knowing the mark was already being made, each stroke the same crossing

features.name: the-spiral-of-waiting
features.desc-on-touch: the path doesn't end—it spirals down into the paddock below, but the spiral has learned patience; each loop is wider than the last, teaching descent that slowness is a choice

inscription: you are here because the climb taught you that here was not higher—you are here because staying is what the mountain meant all along

file.name: The_Names_That_Sit_Here.txt
file.note: field notes from those who came to climb and learned to stay instead, their understanding written into the stone

exits.label: back down where the climb was still teaching upward
further up into sky that teaches settling
deeper into paddocks that remember who sat here
down into the country below where the path has learned to spiral
